shapes.doc: Groom conversation context: stub (or retain) the inline content of tool results linked to stored values. Emitted INLINE in the model's own prose — executed only from current-turn model text (the turn-directive seam), never from history/user/tool content.

items.description: One groom instruction: stub (default) or retain (un-stub) a stored key.
items.title: GroomItem

shapes.doc: Create a project with its tasks and subtasks atomically (one item = one project tree).
Create one task (optional project_id / parent_task_id). Multiple items = multiple tasks.
Create one row of any agent_data resource (RLS + field policy). Items may mix resource_types.
Update one agent_data row by id (RLS + field policy). Idempotent by nature.
Patch one plan.node addressed by node_id or site_id+route. Derived cache (route/depth/labels) is DB-trigger-owned and not patchable.

primary_keyword_phrase.description: Plain-text target keyword — matched to an existing seo.keyword by phrase or created automatically. Prefer this over primary_keyword_id.
primary_keyword_phrase.title: Primary Keyword Phrase

shapes.doc: Apply a declarative content-plan tree to a site (plan.node get-or-create by site+parent+slug — naturally idempotent, never duplicates; topics/sources land as edges). Keywords and topics are plain text — resolved to existing rows or created automatically (entity-owned name resolution). One item = one site's tree.

PlanSourceSpec.description:
A cited source attached to a planned node — lands as a `plan.entity`
row (entity_type='source') plus a `cites` edge.
PlanSourceSpec.title: PlanSourceSpec

PlanTreeNodeSpec.description:
One node in a declarative plan tree (generator output / `plan_tree`
directive item). Derived cache fields are deliberately absent — the DB
trigger owns them.

brief.description: Short bullet points describing what the page must cover.
brief.title: Brief

label.description: Human page title, e.g. 'What is platelet-rich plasma?'
label.title: Label

node_type.description: home = site root · pillar = top-level hub · cluster = grouping hub under a pillar · article = an individual page · index = a listing/directory page.
node_type.title: Node Type

primary_keyword_phrase.description: The page's target keyword as PLAIN TEXT (e.g. 'prp injection for knee'). Matched to an existing seo.keyword or created automatically — never pass an id here, and never omit the keyword because you don't know its id.
primary_keyword_phrase.title: Primary Keyword Phrase

slug.description: kebab-case URL segment (required for every node except home). The full route is derived from the tree — never include slashes.
slug.title: Slug

technical_depth.description: high = genuinely technical/authority content most competitors skip.
technical_depth.title: Technical Depth

topics.description: Topic names as plain text — matched or created automatically.
topics.title: Topics

PlanTreeNodeSpec.title: PlanTreeNodeSpec
